errors.confirm: Tick the confirmation to send the announcement.
errors.date: Enter a valid date and time.

announcements.subtitle: Alerts sent to every member, to a group or to named members.
announcements.heading: Alerts sent
announcements.emptyDescription: Nothing has been sent to the members.

notices.sent: Alert sent. It is delivered in the background.

announcements.newSubtitle: Write a message for the members you choose.

form.heading: Alert
form.description: Members see the title and the start of the text in their notifications.
form.title: Title
form.urlHelp: Optional. A path on this site (starting with /) or an http(s) address that the alert opens. Without one it opens the notifications list.
form.audienceHelp: The sender gets the alert too when they are in the audience.
form.usernamesHelp: Used for named members. Separate them with commas; an unknown name stops the alert.
form.confirmWarning: This notifies everyone in the audience. It is delivered in the background and cannot be recalled or edited.
form.confirmBox: I understand it goes to the audience I chose

notifications.subtitle: What members get for each kind of notification until they choose otherwise.
notifications.heading: Defaults by type
notifications.description: New members start with these. Members who already chose keep their own choice.
notifications.help: A fixed type is always delivered and cannot be changed. A dash means the type does not use that channel.
notifications.followsWatch: Email respects each member's follow setting.

retention.label: Keep read notifications
retention.heading: Read notifications
retention.help: Read notifications older than this are deleted.

email.subtitle: How much mail the forum sends and what it contains.
email.heading: Email
email.description: Applies to notification and digest emails. Security emails are never capped.

mail.label: Mail
mail.offHelp: The forum cannot send email, so none of these settings has an effect yet.

emailHourlyCap.label: Notification emails per hour
emailHourlyCap.help: The most notification emails one member gets in an hour.

conversationEmailIncludesBody.label: Direct message emails
conversationEmailIncludesBody.help: When off, an email about a direct message only says there is one.
conversationEmailIncludesBody.switch: Include the text of the message

digestInactiveDays.label: Weekly digest
digestInactiveDays.help: The digest goes to members who have not visited for at least this long.

notices.subtitle: Banners shown under the header of every page.

list.heading: Notices
list.description: Newest first. Dates are in UTC.

create.heading: New notice
create.description: It is shown at once if it is active and inside its dates.

fields.title: Title
fields.dateHelp: Optional. Date and time in UTC; without a start it is shown at once.

noticeEdit.heading: Notice
noticeEdit.subtitle: Change what the notice says and who sees it.

notices.saved: Notice saved. Members who dismissed it do not see it again.

delete.heading: Delete the notice
delete.warning: The notice and the record of who dismissed it are deleted.

broadcasts.messageSubtitle: Send a direct message to many members at once. Each one gets a conversation of their own.
broadcasts.alertSubtitle: Send an alert to the members you choose with the rule builder: it appears in their alert list and on their devices.

form.messageDescription: The same message goes into one conversation per member, never one conversation with all of them. Each member is also alerted that they were added, and devices that allowed pushes get that alert too.
form.alertDescription: Members see the text in their alerts and, if they allowed it, on their devices.
form.senderHelp: A member's username. Leave empty to send from your own account. Sending as someone else needs authority over that member.
form.title: Title
form.lockedLabel: Lock the conversations: members cannot reply
form.removeFromSenderLabel: Remove each conversation from the sender's list
form.removeFromSenderHelp: Otherwise the sender is in every conversation and sees the replies, which fills the inbox with one conversation per member. If you remove them, replies are not seen by the sender.
form.textHelp: Shown in the alert list and on the device. Up to {max} characters.
form.urlHelp: Optional. A path on this site (starting with /) or an http(s) address that the alert opens. Without one it opens the alerts list.
form.audienceHelp: Banned, erased, unconfirmed and awaiting-approval accounts are never reached.
form.groupsHelp: Members of any of the groups ticked, as their primary or a secondary group.
form.countHelp: Counts the members the send would reach, in the background, without sending anything. Then send what was counted from “Latest run” below.
form.testDescription: Send it only to yourself, or to one member, and see exactly what members will receive. This is real and immediate; it does not start the send.
form.recipientHelp: A member's username. Leave empty to send the test to yourself.

result.countQueued: Counting started. The figures appear under “Latest run”.
result.sendQueued: Sending started. Follow it under “Latest run”.
result.notQueued: A run is already under way. Wait for it or stop it first.

errors.emptyRule: Add at least one condition, or choose Every member.

run.heading: Latest run
run.help: One send or count runs at a time. It works in the background, a few members at a time; you can stop it and resume it.
run.idle: Nothing has been sent or counted yet.
run.progress: Sending the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}”: {percent}. {sent} sent so far.
run.progressCount: Counting for the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}”: {percent}. {matched} members so far.
run.done: The {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” was sent to {sent} members; {skipped} could not be reached.
run.doneCount: The {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” would reach {matched} of {members} members; {skipped} of them could not receive it.
run.stopped: The send of the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” stopped at {percent} with {sent} sent. Resuming continues from there.
run.stoppedCount: The count for the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” stopped at {percent}.
run.failed: The send of the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” stopped by an error at {percent} with {sent} sent: {error}
run.failedCount: The count for the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” stopped by an error at {percent}: {error}
run.stopRequested: It will stop after the chunk it is on.
run.resumeWarning: Continues the stopped send of the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” (started: {started}) with the same content and audience (to change them, discard it and count again). It asks for your password.
run.notQueued: A run is already under way.
run.sendWarning: This sends the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}” to {reachable} members. Counted: {when}. It cannot be recalled. It asks for your password.
run.discardWarning: Gives up the send of the {kind, select, message {direct message} other {alert}} “{summary}”, stopped at {percent} with {sent} sent: what was sent stays sent and the rest is not sent. Then another can be counted and sent. It asks for your password.
run.otherKind: The count that is waiting is for {kind, select, message {a direct message} other {an alert}}: send it from the {kind, select, message {message} other {alert}} page.
run.otherKindStopped: The run that is stopped is {kind, select, message {a direct message} other {an alert}}: resume or discard it from the {kind, select, message {message} other {alert}} page.
